custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 3 on hand.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425700 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425700-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 3 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test, purchase order 1, from any vendor, with a line for part A picked from the lookup, 2 ordered and none received.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO; pick any Vendor, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425700-A in Part Number and pick part A from the list, type 2 in Quantity, click Add, then click Save & Close. Do not click Receive.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Use a desktop browser that can open a second tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
  • Start in browser tab 1 on purchase order 1 (Parts, then Purchase Orders, then open purchase order 1).
